newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli troops kill Palestinian - doctor.
newsitem.headline: Israeli troops kill Palestinian - doctor.

text.p: Israeli troops shot dead a Palestinian man and wounded eight people in a West Bank village on Sunday during a protest against land confiscations, witnesses and a hospital doctor said.
They said the incident occurred in Deir Kidis village near Ramallah where Palestinians say the Israelis have confiscated land for a Jewish settlement.
A doctor at Ramallah hospital who declined to be identified said Atallah Amireh, 36, was shot dead in the chest and head and eight Palestinians were seriously injured.
Israel still occupies much of the West Bank despite having handed over most of its cities to Palestinian self-rule under peace deals with the PLO.
